headline: Seduta mista a Wall Street: Lumentum +8,19% guida i rialzi
headline_en: Mixed session on Wall Street: Lumentum +8.19% leads gainers

paragraphs: Nella seduta del 26 ottobre 2026 l'S&P 500 ha chiuso con 289 societa' in rialzo, 211 in ribasso e 3 invariate, su 503 titoli monitorati. La variazione media dell'indice e' stata di +0,36%.

Settori con la variazione media migliore: Information Technology (+1,55%); Industrials (+1,06%); Energy (+0,38%). Settori piu' debolli: Communication Services (-1,77%); Consumer Staples (-0,54%); Health Care (-0,06%).

In cima alla seduta: Lumentum (LITE, +8,19%), dove MarketWatch riporta: «Why Lumentum’s stock led the S&P 500 higher on Monday»; Comfort Systems USA (FIX, +7,18%); Everpure (P, +6,49%). In fondo: Fair Isaac (FICO, -13,15%); DoorDash (DASH, -6,10%), dove CNBC riporta: «DoorDash reportedly in advanced talks to acquire Instacart»; Charter Communications (CHTR, -5,92%).

Separately, the Wall Street Journal reported that DoorDash is in advanced talks to acquire delivery rival Instacart, and that oil prices fell amid U.S.-Iran diplomatic efforts and Saudi attacks.

Information Technology led sector performance with a 1.55 percent average gain, followed by Industrials at 1.08 percent and Energy at 0.38 percent. Lumentum surged 8.19 percent, leading the S&P 500 higher according to MarketWatch. Synopsys climbed 5.62 percent, while Arm Holdings gained 6.19 percent and Coherent Corp. rose 5.83 percent, all benefiting from the technology sector's strength. Tesla advanced 5.21 percent on news from Reuters that Tesla owners in Slovakia are welcoming the company's assisted-drive technology as the European Union weighs a rollout across the bloc. Lockheed Martin gained 5.13 percent, cited by CNBC as a stock on the move. Comfort Systems USA, Everpure, Bloom Energy, and Akamai Technologies all posted gains of 5 percent or more, though tracked outlets reported no specific company catalysts for those moves.

Communication Services was the worst-performing sector, declining 1.77 percent on average, while Consumer Staples fell 0.49 percent and Health Care edged down 0.03 percent. Fair Isaac led decliners with a 13.15 percent plunge, with no reported catalyst. DoorDash fell 6.1 percent on the news from CNBC that it is in advanced talks to acquire Instacart. Mercado Libre dropped 7.81 percent with no tracked catalyst, while Verizon declined 3.49 percent despite Barron's reporting that Verizon earnings show why its stock is this year's wireless winner. Charter Communications fell 5.92 percent, PayPal declined 3.56 percent, and Reddit dropped 4.02 percent, all without reported company-specific news. MicroStrategy fell 4.24 percent and NVR declined 4.28 percent on no tracked catalysts. Skydance slid 3.6 percent after Reuters reported that the company is offering buyouts to some employees to cut costs following its Warner Bros merger.

markets_brief.prose_html: Le banche centrali rimangono al centro dell'attenzione mentre i trader si posizionano in vista di decisioni politiche cruciali. La Banca del Giappone dovrebbe mantenere i tassi questa settimana pur mantenendo una posizione aggressiva, secondo un sondaggio di CNBC, mentre la rupia indonesiana affronta rinnovate pressioni che potrebbero richiedere aumenti dei tassi più aggressivi per stabilizzare la valuta. L'oro si è stabilizzato vicino a $4.000 mentre i mercati attendono la prossima mossa della Federal Reserve, con gli investitori che valutano le implicazioni per la politica monetaria nelle principali economie. Nel frattempo, i cambiamenti geopolitici stanno ridisegnando i modelli commerciali, poiché Cina e Russia avanzano le loro iniziative commerciali artiche in una sfida agli interessi europei.
markets_brief.prose_html_en: Central banks remain in focus as traders position ahead of key policy decisions. The Bank of Japan is expected to hold rates this week while maintaining a hawkish stance, according to a CNBC survey, while Indonesia's rupiah faces renewed pressure that may require more aggressive rate increases to stabilize the currency. Gold has steadied near $4,000 as markets await the Federal Reserve's next move, with investors weighing the implications for monetary policy across major economies. Meanwhile, geopolitical shifts are reshaping trade patterns, as China and Russia advance their Arctic trade initiatives in a challenge to European interests.
